cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: Generic Product Requirements for CASCaRA Implementation
Product Repository
cas:anEntity.dcterms:description: Product RepositoryThe system shall store all product information in a centralized repository. Trace: ELH-001

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: User and Role Management
cas:anEntity.dcterms:description: User and Role ManagementThe system shall manage authorization through configurable user roles. Trace: ELH-002, EGA-002

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: Audit Trail
cas:anEntity.dcterms:description: Audit TrailThe system shall log all modifications including user, timestamp, and modification reason. Trace: ELH-003, EGA-002

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: Product Variant Model
cas:anEntity.dcterms:description: Product Variant ModelThe system shall maintain configurable product structures and variant definitions. Trace: ELH-004, EGA-003

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: Approval Workflow Management
cas:anEntity.dcterms:description: Approval Workflow ManagementThe system shall support configurable review and approval workflows. Trace: ELH-005, EGA-004

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: Compliance Reporting
cas:anEntity.dcterms:description: Compliance ReportingThe system shall generate audit and compliance reports. Trace: ELH-006, EGA-005

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: Data Exchange Interfaces
cas:anEntity.dcterms:description: Data Exchange InterfacesThe system shall provide interfaces for product information exchange. Trace: ELH-007, ELH-008, EGA-001, EGA-006

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: Consistency Verification
cas:anEntity.dcterms:description: Consistency VerificationThe system shall automatically detect inconsistencies between information sources. Trace: ELH-007, EGA-001

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: Configuration Validation
cas:anEntity.dcterms:description: Configuration ValidationThe system shall validate product configurations against predefined rules. Trace: ELH-004, EGA-003

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: Electronic Approval Records
cas:anEntity.dcterms:description: Electronic Approval RecordsThe system shall maintain electronically signed approval records. Trace: ELH-005, ELH-006, EGA-004
